name: brand-library help
description: Help mode entries for plugin:brand-library. Drafts (draft: true) were written from the code by framework/cli/help-coverage.mjs --draft; edit them into plain English and drop the draft flag.
author: AmberX AXF

entries.title: Light
entries.text: Shows the “Light” part of this screen. Part of Brand library.

entries.title: Dark
entries.text: Shows the “Dark” part of this screen. Part of Brand library.

entries.title: Copy id
entries.text: Copies id. Paste it wherever you need it. Part of Brand library.

entries.title: Opens on
entries.text: Where you set “Opens on”. Change it and the app uses the new value. Part of Brand library.

entries.title: Brand filter
entries.text: Where you set “Brand filter”. Change it and the app uses the new value. Part of Brand library.

entries.title: Large
entries.text: Shows the “Large” part of this screen. Part of Brand library.

entries.title: Show names under tiles
entries.text: Turns “Show names under tiles” on or off. It takes effect straight away and is remembered. Part of Brand library.

entries.title: Play animations
entries.text: Turns “Play animations” on or off. It takes effect straight away and is remembered. Part of Brand library.

entries.title: Open the brand library
entries.text: Opens the brand library. Part of Brand library.

entries.title: Reset the brand
entries.text: Resets the brand. Your own changes go. Part of Brand library.

entries.title: Brand library
entries.text: Shows the “Brand library” part of this screen. Part of Brand library.
